mentions.name: RCHIVE Examiner
mentions.description: A free ncdu-like tool that shows where hard drive space went and what is hogging it. It is a companion to RCHIVE, currently available on the macOS App Store, with Windows and Linux versions releasing soon.
mentions.problem: It is hard to see where hard drive space went and what is consuming it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also have a companion app RCHIVE Examiner [1], which is a free ncdu-like tool to see where the hell all your hard drive space went, and what's hogging it. Currently only in macOS App Store, but Windows and Linux versions are releasing soon.
